verdict.rationale: SharePoint is a SaaS content platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server. The REST, Graph and webhook APIs are developer building blocks an agent integration could be built on, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
